import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get access to different components
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set scan parameters
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # [m]
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # [m]
scan.Scantime = 0.1  # [s] time per line
scan.Lines = 32  # lines per frame

# Set Z controller parameters (PID gains)
zcontrol.PGain = 100
zcontrol.IGain = 6000
zcontrol.DGain = 10

# Perform three scans
for i in range(3):
    scan.StartFrameUp()
    time.sleep(scan.Scantime * scan.Lines)  # Wait for scan to complete
    print(f"Scan {i+1} completed.")

del spm
